page.overview:
Who is Flambo's Brother?

Flambo's Brother is an unseen character from the episode "Dungeon Train". He is the one who described the secret cave that Finn was to explore in a later episode. He was mentioned again in "The Hall of Egress", and was also depicted in a deleted scene (which was most likely cut for time).
